title: Auth Passkey
notes:
This section contains methods for WebAuthn passkey registration, authentication, and management. Methods are invoked behind the `supabase.auth.passkey` namespace.

These methods expose the server side of the WebAuthn ceremony. The client side (the Face ID, Touch ID or security key prompt) has to be performed with a platform passkey API: `navigator.credentials.create()` and `get()` on web, or a passkey plugin on iOS, Android and macOS. Options and credentials are exchanged as `Map<String, dynamic>` in the W3C WebAuthn Level 3 JSON format.

For a one-call alternative that runs the full ceremony, see [`signInWithPasskey()`](/docs/reference/dart/auth-signinwithpasskey) and [`registerPasskey()`](/docs/reference/dart/auth-registerpasskey) on `supabase_flutter`. Android restore keys, created with [`createRestoreKey()`](/docs/reference/dart/auth-createrestorekey), are stored as passkeys too.

The methods that manage the passkeys of the signed-in user throw an `AuthSessionMissingException` when nobody is signed in.

Passkey support is a BETA feature and must be enabled for your project in the Supabase Dashboard under Authentication > Configuration > Passkeys.
